question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Tacit**
solution: The correct answer is: **Explicit**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Tacit"** means something that is understood or implied without being directly stated. (अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से समझा हुआ) • **Example: **Her approval was tacit, as she nodded silently without saying a word. • **"Explicit"** refers to something that is stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt. (स्पष्ट रूप से व्यक्त) • **Example: **The teacher gave explicit instructions for completing the assignment. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Tacit' **is **'Explicit'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Explicit**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Implicit** (अप्रत्यक्ष): Something implied or understood without being directly expressed. • **Example:** Her silence was taken as implicit agreement to the proposal. • **Unstated** (अव्यक्त): Not expressed or mentioned explicitly. • **Example:** The unstated rules of the club were understood by all the members. • **Understood** (समझा हुआ): Something that is comprehended or accepted without being spoken. • **Example:** It was understood that everyone would contribute equally to the project. 42:Ta54, The correct answer is: **Sedative**.
